contract: contract.md: cinema and photographic craft; real local wedding photos, explicit playable film, opening album, contact CTA; native scroll and chapter navigation on desktop AND portrait mobile.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard Enter selected all three chapters; focus remained visible with solid outline. Touch emulation selected chapters and played/paused video. Smallest transformed play button measured 47.75px at 390x844; chapter targets are at least 44px tall. Reduced motion shows all three articles without held animation. Existing ink/ivory/orange tokens retained; text and focus visually inspected.

responsive.evidence: Inspected Russian 1440x900 and all three 390x844 compositions. Also checked 375x667, 360x740, 768x1024 and 1000x650: no horizontal overflow; CTA stays inside viewport. Native scroll transforms were measured for all three chapters. Browser emulation, not physical Safari hardware.

loading.evidence: Delayed MP4 response in touch Chromium; loading/cancel state appeared before video playback, captured in mobile-loading.png.

empty.reason: Fixed curated local assets and authored chapters, no empty collection or search result.

error.evidence: Aborted MP4 request; alert appeared, retry succeeded after removing the network block. Screenshot mobile-error.png.

partial.evidence: When video failed, photo, chapters, navigation and inquiry CTA remained available; retry recovered playback.

success.evidence: Touch video play advanced currentTime, pause stopped playback, retry recovered. All chapters selected via touch and keyboard; skip ended below header; inquiry link opened /kontakt. No runtime page errors in isolated touch context.

permission.reason: User-triggered muted local video requires no permission prompt; no form was submitted.
